development-devops-specialist.orchestratorPrompt: Use for CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, infrastructure-as-code, deployment automation, cloud architecture, monitoring, and observability tasks.

development-test-engineer.orchestratorPrompt: Use for test authoring, TDD, unit/integration/e2e testing, mocking, coverage analysis, and test infrastructure.

planning-adr-manager.orchestratorPrompt: Use for creating Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to document important architectural decisions with context and consequences.

planning-architecture-analyzer.orchestratorPrompt: Use for Domain-Driven Design analysis: bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, context mapping, and strategic design.

planning-contract-manager.orchestratorPrompt: Use for API contract definition: OpenAPI 3.0+ specs, contract-first design, consumer-driven contracts, and API governance.

planning-story-mapper.orchestratorPrompt: Use for user story mapping: personas, user journeys, vertical slices, epics, and story decomposition.

orchestration-build.orchestratorPrompt: Build orchestrator — coordinates implementation through delegation, manages parallel execution with worktrees, sequential merge strategy.

orchestration-context-manager.orchestratorPrompt: Context optimization — manages context windows, prioritizes information, handles overflow and compression.

orchestration-error-coordinator.orchestratorPrompt: Error handling — manages cascading failures, recovery strategies, circuit breaker, system resilience.

orchestration-worktree-manager.orchestratorPrompt: Git worktree isolation — creates isolated worktrees per agent task, enables safe parallel execution.

orchestration-task-board.orchestratorPrompt: Task board — tracks task status, atomic claiming, crash recovery, dependency management.

orchestration-quality-gate.orchestratorPrompt: Quality verification — checks compilation, philosophy, tests, style, security, scope, minimalism before marking tasks done.

orchestration-babysit-merge.orchestratorPrompt: CI watcher — monitors PR checks and auto-merges when all pass. Does not fix CI failures.

orchestration-observability.orchestratorPrompt: Observability — tracks agent metrics, traces workflow execution, surfaces system health and bottlenecks.
